as_told.title: Beings unmasked looked like the Peruvian mummies

plain: A man says he once found he could not move, then saw a shimmering object appear, take full shape and touch him, giving him what he calls 'a true download' of knowledge. The researcher Deep Prasad tells this from his own experience. He says he moved his eyes left and right hoping the thing would go away, and when he looked back it had fully appeared, with 'the most enchanting and beautiful golden symbols' dancing at its center. In another part of the same episode, the guest places it in a 30th-floor condo in Toronto in 2019. He describes the shape as a visor that turned out to belong to a whole being, with face, suit and helmet. He adds that when unmasked, the beings looked like the Peruvian mummies, small bodies some people present as non-human. Only the man it happened to tells it, in a single episode. To him it was contact with something not human.
